name: 249. Chat Completions tool-result cache_control becomes a Converse cachePoint after the toolResult (tool-result-cache-point)
description: Converse has no cachePoint member inside toolResult content (ToolResultContentBlock is document | image | json | searchResult | text | video). On /v1/chat/completions a cache_control on a tool message's content block was emitted as a cachePoint nested inside toolResult.content; Bedrock accepts that with 200 and silently ignores it, so the conversation history up to a tool result was never cached (only system and tools markers took effect). The converter now emits one standalone cachePoint directly after the toolResult block, the shape the Responses route already used. 249.1 and 249.2 echo the outgoing Converse body via x-bf-send-back-raw-request and pin [toolResult, cachePoint, toolResult] with nothing nested, on the unified route and the /openai drop-in. 249.3/249.4 pin the user-visible effect: a tool result carrying {{cachePrefix}} with a marker writes the cache on the first call and reads it back on the identical second call (both were 0 before the fix). Streaming shares the same request converter, so it is not repeated. Not reached by this change: /v1/responses and /anthropic (Responses converter, already sibling), Bedrock Mantle (Anthropic converter, native cache_control), and the /bedrock invoke route (covered by folder 40).
